name: Houston We Have a New Event 2027
information: # Southern Cubing welcomes you to Katy, Texas for Houston We Have a New Event 2027, the first WCA competition in Texas to feature the new Face Turning Octahedron event! # ALL COMPETITORS MUST REVIEW THE 4-PAD INFORMATION TAB BEFORE REGISTERING. # Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue. This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjUxMzcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9863833688a5f44433b5f4dc6d8a75f973072f10/southernCubing%203-01.png)
